name: codemap-boost-codex
description: CodeMap graph and Serena LSP tools for Codex, with isolated runtimes, automatic graph refresh, and complementary text search.

interface.shortDescription: Graph-first code discovery with bundled Serena semantic tools.
interface.longDescription: Bundles code-review-graph and Serena MCP servers with separate private runtimes. Keeps graphs fresh, locates code through graph queries, and uses Serena definitions and references or available tgrep/rg text searches when needed. Serena starts without its dashboard, browser, or GUI log window; activate the actual target project before semantic queries. Weekly background checks validate newer stable tool runtimes before activation; installed copies also refresh the official marketplace through Codex.
defaultPrompt: Set up CodeMap Boost for this Codex environment.
